correctness.rationale: The 14 binary rotation classes partition 64 labeled six-mer vertices and each is a directed cycle, forcing at least 14 deletions. An explicit 14-vertex acyclic witness establishes sharpness. Every size-14 solution chooses exactly one per class, so the exact 181,398,528-choice domain is exhaustive. Pruning a branch only when its already-finalized survivor subgraph has a directed cycle is sound by monotonicity under adding vertices. C++ Kahn topological/longest-path computation and separately authored Python DFS cycle/longest-path computation (with different necklace order) both returned each of the 14 matching frequencies totaling 68,288; the latter explicitly verified the action and orbit counts. Finite full-domain proof, not extrapolation. The optimal mask example and two exceptional symmetry masks are replayable.

originality.rationale: published-finding corpus queries for exact k=6 MDS longest-path multiplicities, 408 minima and 103 symmetry classes found no identical indexed statement. The directly relevant 2023 arXiv and 2024 journal full-text sections state the old total 68,288, known sharp endpoints 13 and 26 and component extrema, but not the complete per-set 14-bin distribution or sharp-minimizer orbit census. Their source code is algorithmic, not a published bin table. All local prior claims were checked for overlap. An unindexed supplemental census remains a specific priority risk.
residual_risks: A public but unindexed supplemental file or generated dataset could encode all 68,288 sets or the same 14-bin histogram; the repository was inspected at README/file-list level but not exhaustively across every historical commit or generated result.

Published generic enumeration permits independent derivation of this finite spectrum; originality is therefore specifically the previously unreported distribution and optimizer symmetry, not the method of generating MDSs or the total/extrema.
Only k=6 is classified, and additional order-six follow-up publications not represented in available search indices could establish the same invariant.

value.rationale: At the first binary order with 68,288 minimum-size selectors, optimizing worst-case uncovered k-mer windows is the motivating objective of the primary sketching literature. The exact entire guarantee distribution establishes how rare sharp optimum 13 is (408/68,288), how many very poor designs exist (48 at 26), and a 103-class reversible symmetry enumeration suitable for benchmarking optimizer sampling/coverage. This is a natural complete classification of an exact performance invariant, not an arbitrary slice or an incremental tweak of the known min/max; it claims no clinical or genome-scale performance benefit.
